scenes.heading: Specializing in a platform or workflow clients rely on

sents.d: Specializing in a platform or workflow clients rely on
Deep expertise in a few tools you're known for beats surface familiarity with everything.

scenes.heading: Go deep on a few tools

sents.d: Becoming genuinely expert in a small set of tools relevant to your specialty (e.g. a specific CRM, project management platform, or e-commerce backend) makes you more valuable and easier to refer than being generically competent across dozens of tools.

Clients often choose a VA specifically because they don't want to train someone from scratch on their exact setup — being the person who already knows their stack removes a major hiring friction point.

Investing time in learning a new in-demand tool occasionally, based on what clients are actually asking for, keeps your skill set aligned with real market demand rather than what was popular when you started.

take: Become the expert in the tools your clients already use.
